newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: TWO COMPANIES TRADE ON MACEDONIA STOCK EXCHANGE.
newsitem.headline: TWO COMPANIES TRADE ON MACEDONIA STOCK EXCHANGE.

text.p: Turnover amounted to 37,650 denars at Tuesday's session of the Macedonian stock exchange as two companies traded, the exchange said.
Oteks Ohrid sold 69 shares at 150 denars, unchanged from the previous close and below par of 1,941 denars.
A total of 20 Usie shares traded at 1,365 denars, flat from April 24 close and below par of 2,664 denars.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
